title: Lost Photo
summary: A scanned evidence photo is bigger than a picture of that size should be. Find out why.
objectives: Inspect the metadata of the image
Find where the image data really ends
Carve out and read what follows it
learningOutcomes: Explain how a file can hide data after its logical end
Identify an embedded file from its signature

references.label: NIST SP 800-86: Guide to Integrating Forensic Techniques into Incident Response
MITRE ATT&CK T1027: Obfuscated Files or Information

hints.bodyMd: Tools like `exiftool` show the embedded comment. It says a note was stored with the scan, but where?
Every PNG ends with an `IEND` chunk. Look at the bytes after it. `binwalk`, or a hex editor searching for the bytes `1f 8b`, will help.
